# BCcampus

> BCcampus champions open education and digital learning innovation across British Columbia's post-secondary institutions through research, grants, and collaborative projects.

BCcampus is a provincial organization dedicated to advancing open educational resources, digital learning strategies, and generative AI implementation in BC's post-secondary system. The organization supports faculty development, funds research initiatives, and provides evidence-based guidance on educational innovation and affordability.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Generative AI
- Open Education
- Digital Learning
- Post-Secondary Education
- Teaching and Learning
- Open Textbooks
- Educational Technology
- Professional Development
- Open Pedagogy
- British Columbia
- FLO (Flexible Learning Objects)
- ETUG (Educational Technology User Group)
- Cost Indicators
- Faculty Development

## Core Organization

- [BCcampus](https://bccampus.ca): BCcampus homepage showcasing open education initiatives in BC
- [About Us](https://bccampus.ca/about-us): BCcampus mission, vision, values, and indigenous reconciliation commitment
- [Celebrating 20 Years of BCcampus](https://bccampus.ca/2023/07/10/celebrating-20-years-of-bccampus): BCcampus 20-year anniversary article highlighting open education milestones

## Active Projects

- [Projects](https://bccampus.ca/projects): Overview of BCcampus projects including Cost Indicators and Open GenAI
- [Open GenAI Project](https://bccampus.ca/projects/open-genai-project): Open GenAI Project developing AI study tools for open educational resources
- [Cost Indicators Project](https://bccampus.ca/projects/cost-indicators): Cost Indicators Project measuring OER adoption and textbook affordability
- [Provincial Curriculum Guides and Supplement Revisions: Health Care Assistant, Access to Practical Nursing, and Practical Nursing](https://bccampus.ca/projects/health-care-assistant-hca-access-to-practical-nursing-apn-and-practical-nursing-pn-curriculum-guides): Provincial nursing curriculum guides and competency framework revisions
- [Sexualized Violence Resources](https://bccampus.ca/projects/sexualized-violence-resources): Training guides and prevention resources for sexual violence in BC post-secondary

## Topics of Practice & Guides

- [Topics of Practice](https://bccampus.ca/topics-of-practice): BCcampus practice areas: open education, digital learning, generative AI
- [Open Education](https://bccampus.ca/topics-of-practice/open-education): Guide to open education, pedagogy, and Creative Commons resources in BC
- [Generative AI: Subject Guide](https://bccampus.ca/topics-of-practice/generative-ai-subject-guide): Generative AI guide and toolkit for educators on responsible implementation
- [Digital Learning in B.C. Post-secondary Institutions](https://bccampus.ca/topics-of-practice/digital-learning): Digital Learning Strategy and advisory resources for BC post-secondary
- [Learning + Teaching](https://bccampus.ca/topics-of-practice/learning-teaching): Faculty development and teaching & learning resources via BCTLC
